findingDetails.title: A path deleted before dispatch is subtracted from detection forever
findingDetails.evidence: detectNewOutOfScopeViolations skips any baseline path whose recorded hash is empty; a deleted-at-baseline path hashes to '' because git hash-object exits non-zero on a missing file (write-containment.ts:787, 425-429).
findingDetails.recommendation: Track a distinct baseline state for unhashable-but-recorded paths (deleted/absent) and re-evaluate them with the content-identity check when they reappear, instead of treating an empty hash as unmatched.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Read the full detection path and baseline snapshot function; grepped the unit suite for a deleted-at-baseline case and found none (write-containment.vitest.ts covers leaf-deletes and leaf-modifies only).

findingDetails.title: The churn detector's first window is never counted
findingDetails.evidence: The sampler's first sample sets previousPaths and contributes newlyDirty=0; the sampler is only fed by the progress heartbeat, which first fires one cadence after dispatch (fanout-run.cjs:3272-3283). Writes landing before that sample are absorbed as the baseline.
findingDetails.recommendation: Seed the detector's first sample from the pre-dispatch baseline snapshot (already captured at fanout-run.cjs:3223-3231) so the first heartbeat window is measured rather than assumed quiet.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Read the detector factory, its call sites, and the heartbeat wiring; confirmed the first sample cannot fire before the first heartbeat by reading startLineageProgressHeartbeat's interval setup.

findingDetails.title: NFR-P01's single-invocation claim undercounts the churn sampler
findingDetails.evidence: Each sample calls snapshotOutOfScopeDirtyPaths, which runs two rev-parse calls (write-containment.ts:385-393 via resolveArtifactScope:616-621), one status --porcelain, and one hash-object per dirty path (write-containment.ts:787). NFR-P01 (spec.md:183) promises one status invocation per heartbeat.
findingDetails.recommendation: Either narrow the sampler to a status-only read (skip hashing when only paths are needed) or amend NFR-P01 to state the real per-heartbeat cost.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Traced the sampler's call chain to the git helpers and counted every spawnSync that executes per sample; no caching exists between samples.

findingDetails.title: The containment repo root can resolve to a subdirectory while all guard paths are repo-relative
findingDetails.evidence: resolveContainmentRepoRoot returns cwd unless the artifact tree lives in a different worktree, while resolveArtifactScope derives artifactRelPosix from repoRoot and compares it against porcelain paths, which git emits relative to the worktree root regardless of -C (verified with git -C specs/system-deep-loop status --porcelain).
findingDetails.recommendation: Resolve the guard root to the git toplevel (the helper already has gitToplevel) or assert that cwd is the toplevel before containment runs.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Read the resolver, its only caller (fanout-run.cjs:2813-2817), and the containment scope math; verified git's porcelain path basis with a live read-only git invocation from a subdirectory.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: Fifteen-file hardened containment change set touching path handling, persistence and shared policy; security-sensitive per the review contract's override list.

targetSelection.selectionReason: The change set's containment decisions live in these three files; the pool was read only for settlement mapping.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The index.lock retry loop can stall a lane.

searchActions.result: Bounded at 250/500/1000/2000 ms, retries only index.lock contention, and records an exhausted budget.

searchLedger.rationale: Backoff is bounded and the failure mode is preserved as a warning.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Bounded retry with a recorded degradation; no unbounded stall path.
